title: How To Create A Landing Page For The Get Matched Form | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Create A Landing Page For The Get Matched Form Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000037630 Follow the instructions below to learn how to create a landing page for the Get Matched Form that looks like this: 1. Create a new static page. Refer to this article for more information: How to Create a New Static Page 2. Add a single row using the table option in the Froala Editor, and add a background color and text as desired: Froala Editor . 3. Add a 1 x 2 table to the static page: 4. Add an image on the left side row and enable the "Image Caption" option to add the desired text: 5. On the right side next to the image, drag and drop the pre-made element Contact Form 6. Change the title and form shortcode to [form=bootstrap_get_match]: 7. Save the changes: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
